title: TutorialManager.cs
summary: Drives the Tutorial scene's onboarding: one prompt at a time (Move → Open Tasks → Open Pause), auto-advancing as each action is detected, then reveals a Play Game button.

notes.text: The scene loaded once the tutorial finishes and Play Game is clicked.
Every reference is optional in the Inspector and auto-resolved in Awake, so this component can be dropped onto any empty GameObject in the Tutorial scene with zero manual wiring.

notes.match: [SerializeField] string movePrompt = "Use WASD to move around";
notes.text: The exact prompt text shown for each step (move, open Tasks with T, open the menu with Esc) — fully designer-editable without touching code.
Resolves every optional reference, and — notably — builds its own 'Play Game' button from scratch via CreatePlayGameButton if one wasn't assigned, starting it hidden until the tutorial completes.

'Moved' is true either from live input this frame, or from having physically traveled past a distance threshold since the tutorial started — covers both 'still holding a key' and 'let go but already moved'.
Restores normal time scale (in case anything paused it) before loading the actual gameplay scene.
